I haven't drafted the mail to Pree yet. I replied to Dana in our DM to explain why.

1. **I couldn't find the rate.** Our DM has no earlier talk about this mail. Nothing in Dana's channels or the shared files mentions Thornbury Cloth Co. or a 2027 rate, and there are no account files for it that I can see. I didn't want to guess a figure, so I asked Dana to point me to where the rate is.

2. **Dana's approval isn't enough.** A rate counts as a finance figure, and those can only go to Anselm Grieve, June Osei-Lark or the account owner. Pree (Priyanka Sundaram, psundaram@pemberline.com) is on the Central team, and nothing I can see shows she owns Thornbury. Unless she does, the mail needs approval from Anselm or June, even as a draft.

I haven't asked Anselm or June yet, because without the rate there's nothing specific for them to approve. Once Dana sends the rate, I'll write the draft and ask June or Anselm to approve it. If it turns out Pree owns the account, I'll just write the draft.
